Odoo for a Slovak accountant

Where the things you know from Slovak bookkeeping live in Odoo — the menus, the roles, and a glossary from účtovný doklad to saldokonto.

EditionOdoo Community

What this guide is for

Odoo was built for an international audience, and its screens use its own words for things a Slovak accountant has known for years under other names. Nothing essential is missing — the podvojné účtovníctvo of the Accounting Act maps onto Odoo cleanly — but the map is not obvious. This guide is that map: where the menus are, who may do what, and a glossary from the Slovak term to the Odoo screen. The other task guides build on it.

It describes Odoo Community with the Slovak localization, as it runs on our hosting. Screens are quoted as an English-speaking user sees them; the Slovak version of this guide quotes the Slovak screens.

The Accounting app

Everything in this guide is in the Accounting app. Its menu bar:

Menu What is in it
Customers issued invoices (Invoices), credit notes, advance invoices, received payments, balance confirmations, customers
Vendors received invoices (Bills), received credit notes (Refunds), received advance invoices, payments and payment orders, netting agreements, vendors
Accounting journal entries, cut-offs and estimated accruals, entries from templates, bank statements (imported or typed) and cash registers, reconciliation, lock dates, currency revaluation, fiscal-year closing
Review every journal item (Journal Items) and the audit trail
Assets fixed assets and their depreciation
Reporting the general ledger, trial balance, journal ledger, open items; the financial statements and the tax returns; the management reports
Configuration settings, chart of accounts, taxes, journals, fiscal positions, analytic accounting, the CZ/SK localization tables, and Guides

Who may do what

A user's Accounting role (Settings → Users & Companies → Users, tab Access Rights) decides what they see:

Role Can
Invoicing issue and receive invoices and register payments — no journal entries, no ledgers
Read-only see everything in accounting, change nothing
Bookkeeper post documents and journal entries, reconcile, run the reports
Accountant all of that, plus configuration: chart of accounts, taxes, journals, settings

The localization adds two roles for the statutory filings — who may prepare a VAT return or control statement and who may file it — so filing can stay with the accountant even where others prepare the returns.

Glossary

You know it as In Odoo Where
účtovný doklad a journal entry — every invoice, payment and internal document is one Accounting → Accounting → Transactions → Journal Entries
účtovný zápis (riadok MD / D) a journal item Accounting → Review → Control → Journal Items
účtový rozvrh Chart of Accounts Accounting → Configuration → Accounting → Chart of Accounts
syntetický / analytický účet an account code: the Slovak chart uses six digits (604000); a sub-account is just another code (604001) the same
denník (chronologický) the Journal Ledger report Accounting → Reporting → OCA accounting reports → Journal Ledger
kniha dokladov, číselný rad a journal: Sales, Purchases, Bank, internal documents… each with its own numbering Accounting → Configuration → Accounting → Journals
hlavná kniha General Ledger Accounting → Reporting → OCA accounting reports
obratová predvaha Trial Balance the same
saldokonto Open Items and Aged Partner Balance the same
odsúhlasenie zostatkov Balance Confirmations Accounting → Customers
zápočet Netting Agreements Accounting → Vendors
párovanie úhrad Reconcile: bank lines and open items matched against each other Accounting → Accounting → Reconcile
interný doklad a journal entry in the internal documents journal, printed as an interný doklad Journal Entries → New; to print it, the gear menu ⚙ → Print → Interní / interný doklad
predkontácia for invoices, the account on the product or product category, mapped by fiscal positions (domestic, EU, export); for internal documents, entry templates Configuration → Accounting → Fiscal Positions; Accounting → Accounting → Create Entry from Template
zaúčtovať Confirm on an invoice or bill, Post on any other entry; until then it is a Draft the button on the document
storno a Credit Note for an invoice; Reverse Entry for any other posted entry the button on the document
červené storno the Storno Accounting setting: reversals use negative amounts on the same side Configuration → Settings
dátum zdaniteľného plnenia Taxable Supply Date on the invoice; the Accounting Date is when it is booked the invoice form
členenie DPH, riadky DP DPH taxes and their tax grids; every line of an entry carries its grids Configuration → Accounting → Taxes; the Tax Grids column on the entry
časové rozlíšenie Cut-offs: accrued and prepaid revenue and expense Accounting → Accounting → Cut-offs
dohadné položky Estimated Accruals Accounting → Accounting → Transactions
dlhodobý majetok, odpisy Assets, computed with Compute Assets; tax depreciation in its own registers Accounting → Assets; Reporting
stredisko, zákazka an analytic account — not a sub-account of the chart Configuration → Analytic Accounting → Analytic Accounts
uzávierka účtovného obdobia Fiscal year closings (closing classes 5 and 6, opening the next year) Accounting → Accounting
účtovná závierka Balance sheet, Income statement and the rest of the statements Accounting → Reporting → Statutory Reports
VS, KS, ŠS Variable / Constant / Specific Symbol on the invoice the invoice form
IČO, DIČ, IČ DPH Company ID, DIČ, Tax ID the company and every partner
bankový výpis, pokladňa Bank Statements, Cash Registers Accounting → Accounting → Bank and Cash

Two traps worth knowing:

  • "Analytic account" is not an analytický účet. In Slovak bookkeeping an analytický účet is a sub-account of the chart (604001 under 604). In Odoo an analytic account is a cost centre or project, tracked alongside the chart. Create sub-accounts in the chart of accounts.
  • "Journal" is not the denník. An Odoo journal is a book of documents with its own numbering (issued invoices, bank, internal documents). The chronological denník the Accounting Act requires is a report across all of them, the Journal Ledger.

Draft, posted, secured

A document is a Draft until you Confirm it (an invoice or bill) or Post it (any other entry); only posted entries count in the ledgers and the tax returns. A posted entry can go back to draft with Reset to Draft while its period is open; otherwise you reverse it.

Accounting → Accounting → Closing → Secure Entries seals posted entries with an unbroken hash chain, so any later change is detectable. It does not close a period — it proves the books were not altered.

Closing a period

Odoo protects a closed period with lock dates: nothing dated on or before a lock date can be posted or changed. Set them in Accounting → Accounting → Lock Dates — only the Accountant role can — and click Update:

Lock date What it locks
Sale Lock Date issued invoices and the rest of the sales journals
Purchase Lock Date received bills and the rest of the purchase journals
Tax Return Lock Date anything that would change the VAT of a period — set it once the DP DPH and KV DPH are filed
Global Lock Date every entry
Hard Lock Date every entry, and it can never be moved back

A lock date cannot lie in the future. The first four can be moved back if a correction turns out to be needed; keep the hard lock date for a year whose účtovná závierka has been filed. Filing a VAT return does not lock its period by itself — set the tax-return lock date after filing.
